item.title: How to set your price without attracting the wrong customers
item.description: A price does more than cover your costs: it tells your market who you're for. Start from what the problem you solve is worth to your ideal customer, price the plan they should choose before the others, then put clear limits on your entry plans. Junior (junior.coach) checks your price against your ideal customer.
